name: PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk
summary: PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk engages in real estate development, healthcare and lifestyle businesses in Indonesia. The company is also involved in investment, development, trading, home care, and financing activities; installation and water treatment; town management; urban development; marketing and building management; clean water and waste management; hotel management; catering service; and provision of accommodation and burial services. PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk founded in 1990 and is based in Tangerang, Indonesia.
